source_binding.source_role: immutable completed F4 same-CFL SaveDt native output
source_binding.hash_policy: worker computes and records SHA256 for every source Part, gzip member, and decompressed roundtrip; preparation records stat only for payload frames

archive_policy.format: one deterministic gzip file per native Part frame
archive_policy.random_access: per-frame gzip members plus immutable original Part tree

resource_plan.storage_basis: raw source bytes + 2GiB working/archive/receipt margin; actual terminal bytes are authoritative
resource_plan.temporary_peak_bytes: one streaming block plus one output gzip member; no decompressed full-frame temporary
